info.name: OAN DA Farmers
info.description: DA Services farmer routes for the My Farmers list, search, profile, holdings, photo, registration and update. Data comes live from the Farmer Registry; the frontend calls only DA Services. Run SSO login first (see 0. Sign in). List farmers stores farmer_id. Saved responses are shortened live responses from the dev registry, 31 Oct - 1 Nov 2026. Guide: docs/farmer-frontend-integration.md.

item.name: 0. Sign in
item.description:
Every request sends Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}} and, when csrf_token is set, X-CSRF-Token: {{csrf_token}} (collection pre-request script).

DA Services forwards these two headers to the Farmer Registry, so a local Login token is refused there with 'Unknown Issuer'. For the farmer routes run SSO login: it stores the Keycloak staff access token and its CSRF value. Login and Refresh still work for routes that do not call the registry, such as Who am I.

request.description: Local DA Services login. Stores access_token and refresh_token. Field names are usr and pwd (username / password give 400). Leave usr and pwd in the environment.

Keycloak login through OAN IAM in one call. Stores access_token and csrf_token; the collection then sends both on every request. Set usr, pwd and sso_key in the environment (sso_key is the login key of the user's role, for example agent). Use this on a deployed server, or whenever a route calls a registry.
The access token lasts 15 minutes. Keep the new refresh_token this returns.
Role, role label, the menu paths that role may open, and its scope.

request.description: One endpoint for the table and the search box. search_text=FR- returns every approved farmer in the caller's scope (Admin: all; DA: assigned kebeles; Supervisor: woreda). Each row carries phone, land in hectares, plot count and photo. The first call after a while takes about 20 s, later calls under 1 s for 10 minutes. Stores farmer_id from the first row.

request.description: Saves every section into one registry draft, then sends it for approval. Returns submission_id and status PENDING_APPROVAL. Use a new client_op_id per registration; a repeat returns DUPLICATE. The FR- id exists only after a supervisor approves. Codes come from Field options and Places.
DRAFT / PENDING_APPROVAL / APPROVED / REJECTED, and the application reference.
